data.cultural_impact: In the Christian context, the name Arela refers to St. Arela of Bimba, a seventh-century Saint from Spain. She was a hermit who lived a secluded life in a cave near the town of Bimba. Despite her solitary existence, she was known for her miraculous healings and answered the prayers of the sick and needy who came to her cave seeking help. The name Arela continues to be revered in Spain and among Spanish Christians as a symbol of selflessness, humility, and devotion.
